newsitem.title: BELGIUM: PetroFina unit finds more gas, oil off Vietnam.
newsitem.headline: PetroFina unit finds more gas, oil off Vietnam.

text.p: Fina Exploration Minh Hai, a company controlled by Belgian oil company PetroFina, said in a statement on Wednesday it discovered oil and gas in an offshore test well near Vietnam.
It said the discovery, the fifth offshore southwest Vietnam, was in Block 46.

Tests in the area have been successful since July of last year. In February the company said it would undertake a seismic acquisition programme to define the potential for the integrated development of the area.

If the production-sharing partners, Fina and Sodec Vietnam, a subsidiary of Showa Shell, decide to enter into a development, Vietnamese state company Petrovietnam would have the option of acquiring a stake of up to 15 percent.

The two partners announced on February 3 the discovery of gas and condensate in Block 51, in which Fina Exploration Minh Hai has a 75 percent interest. As in Block 46, if the development project goes ahead, PetroVietnam may acquire a 15 percent interest.
Block 46 is located in the Malay Basin, 130 km south west of Nam Can.
